Sound Bath & Manifest Circle

An evening to reset, release and realign. A full hour of sound on a private deck under the trees, followed by the part most sound baths skip: a guided circle where you name what you are letting go of, and what you actually want next.

  • 60-minute sound bath with 18 different instruments
  • Guided manifestation circle and journaling
  • 7-Day Manifestation Journal to keep, a $25 value
  • Welcome refreshments, light snacks and free parking
  • The Soul Nest, Charlotte NC · limited to 15 guests
